method.title: How coverage is calculated
method.description: Every lesson contributes three knowledge slots: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. A slot becomes covered after a valid review of the current content revision, and becomes durably retained once it reaches review state with an interval of at least 21 days. A slot can belong to multiple topics, so topic rows are not added together.
